answer.says: The system of needs has no holiday. It merely changes its shape. Tell me, friend, do you close your shop for Diwali, or does the need for books persist even in the haze?
answer.thought: The brown haze chokes the air, a physical manifestation of the indeterminate spirit that refuses to clarify itself. I am still in the system of needs, having just consumed the chole bhature, and the bookseller stands before me as the particular embodiment of the universal drive to know. I must press him to see if his trade, like the state, has an ethical core or if it is mere arbitrage.
